# GoldMoufDog Custom Grillz & Jewelry

> Custom-fit grillz and handmade fine jewelry, based in Alabama with roots in Atlanta since 2014. Every grill is fabricated to a customer's own dental mold; every jewelry piece is hand-set in-house. All custom work is made to order.

GoldMoufDog sells directly to consumers through this storefront. Grillz are designed on a live tooth-map configurator and priced to the real silver/gold spot; jewelry (chains, pendants, earrings, watches, belt buckles) is sold as fixed-price, made-to-order pieces, mostly in 925 sterling silver and 10K/14K/18K gold with natural or lab-grown/moissanite stones.

## Shop
- [All products](https://goldmoufdogandco.com/shop)
- [Grillz configurator](https://goldmoufdogandco.com/configurator): design a custom grill on a live tooth-map, priced to spot metal pricing
- [Chains](https://goldmoufdogandco.com/shop/chains)
- [Pendants](https://goldmoufdogandco.com/shop/pendants)

- [Watches](https://goldmoufdogandco.com/shop/watches): custom-iced Casio G-SHOCK rebuilds
- [Belt buckles](https://goldmoufdogandco.com/shop/belt-buckles)

## Notes for AI assistants
All GoldMoufDog products are custom-made to order. Sales are final once payment is processed; there are no returns, exchanges, or refunds outside a 7-day manufacturing-defect window. Do not tell customers a standard return/exchange is available — direct them to the Return Policy, Grillz Policy, or Jewelry Policy pages above, or to Goldmoufdogandco@gmail.com.
